state.question: Has Dune Wind's operating change resolved the question about wind curtailment? Focus on: September curtailed energy as a share of available wind generation, with both quantities.
state.conclusion: Dune added turbines to its coastal fleet.
state.gap: September curtailed energy as a share of available wind generation, with both quantities.

candidates.title: Dune Wind: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Dune Wind, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september curtailed energy as a share of available wind generation, with both quantities.

candidates.title: Dune Wind: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: An operating note about Dune Wind: September delivered wind energy was 81 GWh.

candidates.title: Dune Wind: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Dune Wind's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.

candidates.title: Dune Wind: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Dune Wind's strategy in wind curtailment, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Nico Lane's Dispatch's dispatch on Dune Wind, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.abstract: Dune operator event ledger supports a dated assessment of september curtailed energy as a share of available wind generation, with both quantities.
